HU Zongmiao, FENG Qinqin, MI Shouhu, LEI Yuechen, GUO Jianfang Norinco General Hospital, Xi’an 710065, Shaanxi, China Abstract Objective By optimizing the rule base of the prescription automatic screening system (PASS), we can increase the warning of drug interactions, reduce adverse interactions in drug treatment, and improve the ability of pharmaceutical care. Methods According to the common unreasonable situation of combined drug use in the hospital in recent years, determine the drug interaction content to be optimized. Through user-defined optimization of PASS system, the rationality of medication was reviewed in real time by artificial intelligence. The optimization effect of PASS system was evaluated by comparing the proportion of adverse interaction medical records before and after optimization. Results A total of 1112 warning messages about irrational drug combination were customized and maintained. After system optimization, the proportion of medical records with adverse interactions decreased significantly from 4.483% to 2.040%. Conclusion The optimization of PASS system can significantly reduce the adverse drug interactions and medical orders, and improve the service ability of pharmacists.Keywords PASS;
